[[File:Video_book.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lumpawarrump uses a video book.]]
A '''book-like piece of technology''' that could display videos was used by the young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. He watched a [[Unidentified Rebel cartoon|cartoon]] about the exploits of his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], on the video book, but switched the screen to instead display a simple game when a curious [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|Imperial commander]] came to investigate.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While referred to as a video book in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''{{'s}} script, the item has not been named in [[canon]].
